tagline: Mediterranean adventure with world-class coasters and themed lands.
description: PortAventura Park is a major theme park resort near Salou, Spain, featuring multiple themed areas, roller coasters, family rides, and seasonal events.

rides.name: Shambhala
rides.shortDescription: Hypercoaster with big drops and lots of airtime.
tips: Ride early or late to avoid peak queues.
Front row gives stronger wind; back row gives stronger airtime.

firstTimer: Arrive 30–45 minutes before opening to get a head start.
Prioritize top coasters early; family areas later.
crowdStrategy: Do the most popular rides at rope-drop and during parades/shows.
Eat lunch earlier than usual to avoid queues.
withKids: Start in SésamoAventura for shorter waits early.
Bring snacks/water; lines can be long in the afternoon.
rainyDay: Focus on indoor shows/attractions and restaurants until weather improves.

transport: Train to Salou/PortAventura station (depending on season/services).
Car: paid parking typically available on-site.
accessibilityNotes: Check the park’s accessibility guide for ride restrictions and services.
